appStoreApps.title: App Store apps
appStoreApps.description: Apple App Store apps to fetch. Accepts numeric app IDs (e.g. 443904275) or full store URLs (e.g. https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/line/id443904275).

googlePlayApps.title: Google Play apps
googlePlayApps.description: Google Play apps to fetch. Accepts package names (e.g. jp.naver.line.android) or full store URLs (e.g. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.naver.line.android).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code of the store front (jp, us, gb, de, ...). Applies to both stores.

language.title: Language (Google Play only)
language.description: Two-letter language code for Google Play reviews (ja, en, de, ...). App Store reviews follow the country automatically.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Upper limit of reviews fetched per app per store. App Store RSS serves at most ~500 recent reviews (10 pages x 50).

sinceDays.title: Only reviews from the last N days
sinceDays.description: Optional. Keep only reviews newer than N days ago — e.g. 1 for a daily scheduled run, 7 for weekly. Recommended for monitoring: the window moves with each run, so you only pay for recent reviews. Takes priority over sinceDate.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews after (ISO date)
sinceDate.description: Optional. Keep only reviews newer than a fixed date, e.g. 2026-08-15. For scheduled monitoring prefer sinceDays: a fixed date makes each later run fetch (and charge for) a growing range.
